entities.name: Salomon, King of Brittany
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Salomon was count of Rennes and Nantes from 852 and duke of Brittany from 857 until his assassination in 874. In 867, he was granted the counties of Avranches and Coutances, and he used the title king of Brittany intermittently after 868.
